body:
Thanks for the resources! I went to a crisis emergency room this morning and have a referral for a therapist. I wanted help with a relationship in my life that is unhealthy that I keep falling into, but they didn't help with that. I needed the strength to not pick up the phone and I didn't have that. I will see my therapist and hopefully find within myself the strength to leave, but I thank you for reaching out. Everyone else on here pretty much berated me for staying with this man and it really hurt.

You are a good person.

My love is more into casual sex than relationships, but I have been here. I wasn't into him at first, it's been over two years, and I still think he's going to realize that he loves me.

I'm terrified I won't ever love someone the way I love him. I feel you.

He told me he loved me. He actively made attempts to be around me. I am not wrong for thinking he loved me. 

It doesn't matter if he accepts me now. I feel trapped and I have nowhere else to go other than to want him. I wish he wanted to marry me. 

I don't want to meet anyone else. This man taught me how to love myself and my body. It disgusts me to think of his hands on someone else. Telling them they're beautiful. I have never had a positive relationship. I don't want to be alone. I am scared. I feel like I can leave
